name: Tailwind Spin Ring
css:
.loader { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); border-radius: 9999px; border: calc(var(--loader-size) * .09) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--loader-color) 18%, transparent); border-top-color: var(--loader-color); animation: twSpin var(--loader-speed) linear infinite; }
@keyframes twSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
tailwind: <span className="inline-block h-14 w-14 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-indigo-500/20 border-t-indigo-500" />
